sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.text_preview: H IGH-SPEED digital systems may experience voltage supply variations as large as 10% in both their internal and I/O supply levels. As a result, supply and substrate noise are often the major causes of jitter in a phase-locked loop’s (PLL) output clock [1].
